title: Eventing a 1 on 1 Battle System With Captures Question

posts.author: WhaleYan
posts.body:
Good day,
Currently I've found myself in a bit of a touch situation when it comes to evening. I have access to VisuStella's party plugin but I'm thinking eventing may be the way to go with this.
Effectively what I'm looking for is to create a system where the "Reserve" party is limited to 5 members and the "Primary" party is the only one active.
Using plug ins and eventing I've achieved a singular party member active only and made a simple capture enemy mechanic that converts them into actors. However the "Reserve" capacity goes far beyond my intended 5 total and offers the player too many resources.
Is there a way to event a restricted system like this? Or would this require additional plug ins?
Additionally is there a way to create a system where if Actor X joins the party and reserve party is >5, they are sent to a separate map?
Thanks.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
It's very hard to answer question like this without seeing everything you've done with your events.
There are a good number of plugins designed to emulate Pokémon gameplay, have you looked into simply using those?
WhaleYan said:
Additionally is there a way to create a system where if Actor X joins the party and reserve party is >5, they are sent to a separate map?
Click to expand...
I don't know what you're asking here - there's no such thing as an actor on a map.
The only things on maps are your player character, followers representing your party members (if you have them turned on), and events.

To break it down a bit simpler - I am simply looking for a way to create an event where if reserve party contains more than 5 members then enough members must be removed until reserve party is 5 or less.
Could I use a game data variable for this? Or possibly a plugin command?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
How new are you to RPG Maker? If you haven't already done this, I strongly recommend you take some time to do tutorials and make some small practice games.
If you're not familiar with how the default engine works and how to do things via events, it's going to be difficult to jump straight into modifying things with plugins (or complex events).
WhaleYan said:
I've tried to find some pokemon style plug ins but most of which seem to be XP only which from my understanding are incompatible.
Click to expand...
There are no plugins for XP, or any RPG Maker before MV. Older makers had scripts, which worked differently and shouldn't be likely to come up when you're Googling plugins.
WhaleYan said:
If you know of any I'd love to know.
Click to expand...
The Synrec plugin
@Sword_of_Dusk
linked I believe handles a lot of the capturing and party stuff you want.
SumRandomDde has a whole handful of Pokémon-themed plugins written for MV, some number of which should work fine in MZ.
Unsupported MV Plugin List – RPG Maker MZ Plugins
sumrndm.site
WhaleYan said:
To break it down a bit simpler - I am simply looking for a way to create an event where if reserve party contains more than 5 members then enough members must be removed until reserve party is 5 or less.
Click to expand...
You can use Control Variables to put the number of party members in a variable. Then Conditional Branch to check whether that variable is greater than 5.
Do the commands to remove someone. Put it all in a Loop command.
I don't know how this interacts with your VisuStella plugin (or even if that's useful for what you want to do).
